item.text:
{"program":"domain(person,[simba,yummers,rhys]).

% Simba feels invincible.
axiom(s1, invincible(simba)).

% If Simba either learns from mistakes or listens to others (but not both), then he values wisdom.
axiom(s2, rule([xor(learns_from_mistakes(simba),listens_to_others(simba))],values_wisdom(simba))).

% Yummers feels invincible.
axiom(s3, invincible(yummers)).

% Simba does not develop caution.
axiom(s4, not(develops_caution(simba))).

% Simba either follows the advice of his elders or exhibits impulsive behavior, but not both.
axiom(s5, xor(follows_advice_of_elders(simba),exhibits_impulsive_behavior(simba))).

% Simba seeks adventure.
axiom(s6, seeks_adventure(simba)).

% Simba respects experience.
axiom(s7, respects_experience(simba)).

% If Simba avoids reckless behavior, then he values wisdom.
axiom(s8, rule([avoids_reckless_behavior(simba)],values_wisdom(simba))).

% Rhys respects experience.
axiom(s9, respects_experience(rhys)).

% Every lion who feels invincible either asserts dominance or has confidence (or both).
axiom(s10, rule([invincible(X)],or(asserts_dominance(X),confidence(X)))).

% Every lion who takes risks either develops caution or learns from mistakes (or both).
axiom(s11, rule([takes_risks(X)],or(develops_caution(X),learns_from_mistakes(X)))).

% For all lions, if they have confidence and seek adventure, then they take risks.
axiom(s12, rule([and(confidence(X),seeks_adventure(X))],takes_risks(X))).

% If Simba values wisdom and respects experience, then he follows the advice of his elders.
axiom(s13, rule([and(values_wisdom(simba),respects_experience(simba))],follows_advice_of_elders(simba))).

% Any lion that respects tradition or values prudence follows the advice of their elders.
axiom(s14, rule([or(respects_tradition(X),values_prudence(X))],follows_advice_of_elders(X))).

% Simba does not listen to others.
axiom(s15, not(listens_to_others(simba))).

% Simba does not assert dominance.
axiom(s16, not(asserts_dominance(simba))).","query":"labelled_explanation(not(face_danger(simba)),Status,Package)"}
